challenges.title: Can you fix the learning rate?
challenges.description: This neural network should learn XOR, but its learning rate is far too large. Train it, watch it fail, then fix the learning rate.
challenges.objective: See that a correct algorithm can still fail because of its configuration.
hints: Look at the loss curve: it rises instead of falling. Every step overshoots.
Learning rates for this network usually work between 0.05 and 1.
challenges.explanation: With learning rate 20 every update overshoots the minimum and the network saturates into confident wrong answers - the loss explodes. A smaller learning rate takes steps small enough to follow the loss surface downhill. The algorithm never changed; only its configuration did.
